Et reversus est Moyses de monte,
And Moses returned from the mountain,
portans duas tabulas testimonii in manu sua,
carrying the two tablets of the testimony in his hand,
and accomplished by the work of God.
scriptura quoque Dei erat sculpta in tabulis.

Non est clamor adhortantium ad pugnam,
